vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sql-generator
Version: 2.3.2

The skill bundle is a legitimate SQL template generator that provides boilerplate DDL, DML, and optimization advice. The primary logic in `scripts/sql.sh` uses static templates and basic string matching to output SQL code to stdout without executing it or accessing sensitive system resources, network, or environment variables. No evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions match its stated purpose (SQL generation and helpers); it has no network installs or secret requests and the included script only emits SQL templates locally.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (SQL generator, DDL, mock data, migration, optimizer) align with the provided assets: SKILL.md, tips.md, and a bash script (scripts/sql.sh) that generates DDL, queries and related SQL snippets.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains scoped usage and commands for SQL tasks and does not instruct the agent to read arbitrary system files, credentials, or send data to external endpoints. The provided script formats and prints SQL; it does not reference external services or other system config paths.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification or external downloads are present. The skill is instruction-only with an included local shell script, so nothing is fetched from the network at install time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script does not read environment secrets; its outputs are SQL templates and examples only.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. It is user-invocable and will not gain persistent elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to generating SQL text. Before running local scripts, you may want to quickly read scripts/sql.sh to confirm no unexpected network or shell actions (the visible portion only uses standard shell utilities and heredocs). The skill does not request DB credentials, but if you or the agent later supply database connection strings to run generated SQL, treat those credentials like any sensitive secret (don't paste them into public chat). If you need absolute assurance, run the script in an isolated environment or review the remainder of the file (it was truncated in the bundle listing) to confirm there are no hidden network calls or execs.
